title: Undirected adjacency from an edge list
hints: adj = defaultdict(set); then adj[a].add(b) never needs an 'is the key there yet' check.
Add both directions for every edge, but skip the add when a == b. Simply evaluating adj[a] creates the key with an empty set.
Return dict(adj) so the result is a normal dict; for neighbors use sorted(adj.get(node, ())).
